videoTitle: Why Your Surgeon Skipped the Smaller Back Surgery
videoDescription: Your surgeon says you need disc replacement instead of microdiscectomy. That recommendation tells you something specific about what they see on your MRI—and what happens if the smaller surgery fails. Find out what to ask before you decide at mindtivate.com
script: When your surgeon says microdiscectomy won't work and you need disc replacement instead, they're telling you your remaining disc is too degenerated—meaning even if they remove the herniation, you'll likely re-herniate within...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
